title: Free plate thickness resonances, P and S (analytic)
description:
A 1 mm solid plate (silica-like, 100 cells of 10 um across x) between vacuum cells (no material: traction-free surfaces), periodic in y (4 cells), rigid outer x faces behind the vacuum (never reached). Two traction sheets on one vertical line inside the plate (x and y direction, Ricker 3 MHz) start plane P (v_x) and S (v_y) waves that ring between the free surfaces for 20 us (~1-2 s per run). The material is given by c11 / c12 / c22 / c66; the sweep c66_ratio = 1.6 makes it orthotropic (c66 raised, c22 = c11), whose stable time step needs the anisotropic stability stiffness (lambda_max = 97 GPa > c11 = 78 GPa); c66_ratio = 1 (last) is isotropic silica.
Analytic (1D, free-free): modes cos(n pi xi / d), xi from the lower plate face, f_n = n v / (2 d) with v = sqrt(c11 / rho) (P, 2.98 MHz steps) or sqrt(c66 / rho) (S, 1.88 MHz steps). On the staggered grid both are exact discrete modes with d = N dx (P: half-mass faces on the free surfaces; S: zero corner shear there), f_n = asin((v dt / dx) sin(n pi / (2 N))) / (pi dt), within 4e-4 of n v / (2 d) for n <= 3. After the pulse v(xi, t) = sum_n (2 T / (rho d)) G(f_n) cos(n pi xi_s / d) cos(n pi xi / d) cos(2 pi f_n (t - t0)), G(f) = (2 / sqrt(pi)) f^2 / f0^3 exp(-(f / f0)^2) the Ricker spectrum, t0 = 4 / f0 (P: times cos(n pi / (2 N)) for the sheet split over two faces; v_x sits on the +x cell face).
Derived values tab: fP1_res, fP2_res, fS1_res, fS2_res, fS3_res = frequencies of the resonance finders (acoustics.res_p on v_x, acoustics.res_s on v_y) vs the discrete f_n (expected ~1e-5; tolerance 1e-3, below the 1 % of a plate one cell too thick); AP1 / AS1 / AS2 _lockin = sin^2-windowed lock-in amplitudes at the probe vs the modal amplitudes (expected well below 1 %; tolerance 2 %).
Probes tab: probe_vx / probe_vy with the dashed modal sums after T_lock.
Line profile tab: vx_profile / vy_profile across the plate at the final time vs the modal sums (P n <= 3, S n <= 5; they test the phases after ~60 periods; tolerance 3 % of the range).
Sweep tab: fS1_res versus c66_ratio with the dashed fS1_vs_ratio.

parameters.name: f0
parameters.description: Ricker peak frequency of both sheets

parameters.name: t0_r
parameters.description: time of the Ricker maximum (the waveform's t0); the pulse ends at 2 t0

parameters.name: T_sheet
parameters.description: peak traction of each sheet in Pa

parameters.name: rho_s
parameters.description: plate density in kg/m^3

parameters.name: cL_s
parameters.description: isotropic longitudinal speed in m/s (sets c11 = c22)

parameters.name: cS_s
parameters.description: isotropic shear speed in m/s (sets c66 at c66_ratio = 1)

parameters.name: c66_ratio
parameters.description: c66 over its isotropic value rho cS^2 (swept: 1.6 = orthotropic, 1 = isotropic)

parameters.name: c11_s
parameters.description: stiffness c11 = c22 in Pa (78.1 GPa)

parameters.name: c12_s
parameters.description: stiffness c12 in Pa (isotropic lambda, 16.0 GPa)

parameters.name: c66_s
parameters.description: shear stiffness c66 in Pa (31.1 GPa x c66_ratio)

parameters.name: v_P
parameters.description: P speed along x in m/s

parameters.name: v_S
parameters.description: S speed along x in m/s

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size

parameters.name: N_cells
parameters.description: plate cells across x

parameters.name: d_plate
parameters.description: plate thickness (between the free faces, on cell edges)

parameters.name: x0_plate
parameters.description: lower plate face (two vacuum cells below it)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: domain width: plate plus two vacuum cells each side

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: domain height (periodic y: plane waves)

parameters.name: y_mid
parameters.description: y of the probe and the profile line (a cell centre)

parameters.name: xi_s
parameters.description: sheet position from the lower face (a cell centre; its normal traction sits on the faces at 13 and 14 dx)

parameters.name: xi_vy
parameters.description: probe cell centre from the lower face (v_y node)

parameters.name: xi_vx
parameters.description: v_x node of the probe cell (its +x face)

parameters.name: S_courant
parameters.description: courant setting

parameters.name: p_st
parameters.description: stability tensor entry c11 wx + c66 wy (square cells: wx = wy = 1/2)

parameters.name: q_st
parameters.description: stability tensor entry c66 wx + c22 wy

parameters.name: r_st
parameters.description: stability tensor off-diagonal |c12 + c66| sqrt(wx wy)

parameters.name: S_stab
parameters.expression: max((p_st + q_st)/2 + hypot((p_st - q_st)/2, r_st), c11_s)
parameters.description: stability stiffness lambda_max, at least c11 (78.1 GPa isotropic, 96.9 GPa at c66_ratio 1.6)

parameters.name: dt_ac
parameters.description: acoustic step: courant / (sqrt(S_stab * 2 / rho) sqrt(2) / dx), the solid-vacuum faces having rho / 2 (7.55e-10 s isotropic)

parameters.name: T_run
parameters.description: study duration

parameters.name: t_end
parameters.description: final time: the tick nearest T_run

parameters.name: t_vel
parameters.description: time of the final velocities (half a step before t_end)

parameters.name: T_lock
parameters.description: start of the lock-in window (the pulse ends at 2 t0 = 2.67 us)

parameters.name: drive
parameters.description: modal drive 2 T / (rho d) in m/s^2

parameters.name: fP1
parameters.description: P mode 1 (discrete exact) in Hz

parameters.name: fP2
parameters.description: P mode 2 in Hz

parameters.name: fP3
parameters.description: P mode 3 in Hz (weak)

parameters.name: fS1
parameters.description: S mode 1 (discrete exact) in Hz

parameters.name: fS2
parameters.description: S mode 2 in Hz

parameters.name: fS3
parameters.description: S mode 3 in Hz

parameters.name: fS4
parameters.description: S mode 4 in Hz (weak)

parameters.name: fS5
parameters.description: S mode 5 in Hz (weak)

parameters.name: BP1
parameters.description: P mode 1 velocity amplitude per unit mode shape in m/s

parameters.name: BP2
parameters.description: P mode 2 amplitude in m/s

parameters.name: BP3
parameters.description: P mode 3 amplitude in m/s

parameters.name: BS1
parameters.description: S mode 1 velocity amplitude per unit mode shape in m/s

parameters.name: BS2
parameters.description: S mode 2 amplitude in m/s

parameters.name: BS3
parameters.description: S mode 3 amplitude in m/s

parameters.name: BS4
parameters.description: S mode 4 amplitude in m/s

parameters.name: BS5
parameters.description: S mode 5 amplitude in m/s

parameters.name: AP1
parameters.description: P mode 1 ring-down amplitude of probe v_x in m/s

parameters.name: AS1
parameters.description: S mode 1 ring-down amplitude of probe v_y in m/s

parameters.name: AS2
parameters.description: S mode 2 ring-down amplitude of probe v_y in m/s

analytic_curves.name: vx_modal_sum
analytic_curves.expression: where(t > T_lock, BP1*cos(pi*xi_vx/d_plate)*cos(2*pi*fP1*(t - t0_r)) + BP2*cos(2*pi*xi_vx/d_plate)*cos(2*pi*fP2*(t - t0_r)) + BP3*cos(3*pi*xi_vx/d_plate)*cos(2*pi*fP3*(t - t0_r)), 0)

analytic_curves.name: vy_modal_sum
analytic_curves.expression: where(t > T_lock, BS1*cos(pi*xi_vy/d_plate)*cos(2*pi*fS1*(t - t0_r)) + BS2*cos(2*pi*xi_vy/d_plate)*cos(2*pi*fS2*(t - t0_r)) + BS3*cos(3*pi*xi_vy/d_plate)*cos(2*pi*fS3*(t - t0_r)) + BS4*cos(4*pi*xi_vy/d_plate)*cos(2*pi*fS4*(t - t0_r)) + BS5*cos(5*pi*xi_vy/d_plate)*cos(2*pi*fS5*(t - t0_r)), 0)

analytic_curves.name: vx_profile
analytic_curves.expression: BP1*cos(pi*(x - x0_plate + dx_cell/2)/d_plate)*cos(2*pi*fP1*(t_vel - t0_r)) + BP2*cos(2*pi*(x - x0_plate + dx_cell/2)/d_plate)*cos(2*pi*fP2*(t_vel - t0_r)) + BP3*cos(3*pi*(x - x0_plate + dx_cell/2)/d_plate)*cos(2*pi*fP3*(t_vel - t0_r))

analytic_curves.name: vy_profile
analytic_curves.expression: BS1*cos(pi*(x - x0_plate)/d_plate)*cos(2*pi*fS1*(t_vel - t0_r)) + BS2*cos(2*pi*(x - x0_plate)/d_plate)*cos(2*pi*fS2*(t_vel - t0_r)) + BS3*cos(3*pi*(x - x0_plate)/d_plate)*cos(2*pi*fS3*(t_vel - t0_r)) + BS4*cos(4*pi*(x - x0_plate)/d_plate)*cos(2*pi*fS4*(t_vel - t0_r)) + BS5*cos(5*pi*(x - x0_plate)/d_plate)*cos(2*pi*fS5*(t_vel - t0_r))
